text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Let's set out together to find tomes 
chronicling 
the bonds between Umamusume and humans 
that even Azuma-san has yet to see—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Some time after making that promise, 
she contacted me saying she was able 
to arrange some time away.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Now then. 
Let us depart in search of ancient tomes.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When it comes to books preserved by 
private individuals, 
long-established shops or ancestral family 
homes seemed the best bet. 
So the two of us set off to visit some 
right away.

text_block_list.name: Traditional Japanese Confectionery Store Owner
text_block_list.text:
I'm so sorry, dear. 
I'm afraid we don't have any books like 
that here.

text_block_list.name: Middle-Aged Woman
text_block_list.text:
After my mother-in-law's funeral, 
we ended up throwing everything out all at 
once, you see...

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
It appears those who preserve books across 
generations 
are few and far between.
choice_data_list:
Yeah. I was hoping we'd find at least one 
volume, but...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Azuma-san, Trainer-san! 
Are you two lookin' for somethin'?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Old books, huh...? Oh, I know! 
How'd ya like to head over to my 
relatives' place right now?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
When they moved here from Morioka, they 
said they brought 
eeevery last book from their storehouse 
with 'em! 
Whaddya say? Care to take a peek?

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
What a fortunate stroke of serendipity. 
Yukino-sama, you have my deepest gratitude 
for your thoughtfulness.

text_block_list.name: Yukino's Relative
text_block_list.text:
Ah, come on in! 
I've got the books brought out for ya.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Waaah, thank you kindly! 
Whoa, that really is a heap of 'em~. 
So many difficult-lookin' books...

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Magnificent. 
Every single one is an excellent volume, 
in splendid condition.

text_block_list.name: Yukino's Relative
text_block_list.text:
My late old man truly loved his books. 
I'm sure he'd be thrilled to know they're 
bein' put to good use.
choice_data_list:
Azuma-san, see any books that aren't in 
the archives?

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. The two piled on the desk 
are volumes that even I have never laid 
eyes upon before.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
And that one over there, which I glanced 
at earlier... 
It was truly delightful.

text_block_list.name: Yukino's Relative
text_block_list.text:
Took a liking to the old man's diary full 
of lovey-dovey bragging, did ya? 
Readin' it makes my face turn bright red, 
I tell ya.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The diary was a richly emotional chronicle 
of their journey, 
weathering the tumultuous shifts of the 
era side by side 
with the horsegirl he held dear.
choice_data_list: They must have been a wonderful couple...

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
A horsegirl and a human crossing paths, 
choosing to walk through life together, 
and triumphing over hardship after 
hardship.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
It is, in truth, the record of a most 
sacred journey.
choice_data_list:
Would you mind sharing some stories about 
them?

text_block_list.name: Yukino's Relative
text_block_list.text:
Sure thing! 
We heard about 'em practically every day 
growin' up, 
so we've got tons of stories to tell~!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Me too, me too! 
I've got stories from when I was just a 
little kid!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After listening to their cherished 
memories, 
I received the manuscript and parted ways 
with Azuma-san and Yukino Bijin—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I visited Azuma-san, she was sitting 
in a corner 
of the hall with a brush in hand, writing 
something down.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Greetings, Trainer. 
How kind of you to deliver this in person.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Nay, this is no official duty... 
Merely a personal diary I pen for myself.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Tracing each memory, inscribing it onto 
parchment, 
and etching it deep into my very being—

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
It is but part of how I continue 
to watch over horsegirls and humans alike.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
With each passage I commit to ink, the 
memories accumulate, 
etching themselves ever more vividly into 
my heart.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
And today, another has been added, thanks 
to you.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Meeting together, venturing forth 
to that place known as an "arcade"—

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Searching for manuscripts, visiting 
various shops 
and homes alongside you... Every moment 
was captivating.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
And the fond memories shared by 
Yukino-sama's kin 
were all so radiant, bringing the vivid 
scenes 
of those days to life before my eyes.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
All of them truly precious moments... 
Moments that spur my brush across the page 
of its own accord.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Memories turn into records, enduring 
through time, 
and opening a page breathes life into 
bygone days once more—

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
From this page as well, 
the memories of this day may be retraced.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, upon returning to my room, 
I pulled an unused notebook from my desk 
drawer.
choice_data_list: Maybe I'll start keeping a diary too.
Maybe I'll start keeping a diary too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If I could experience life the way 
Azuma-san does, 
it would surely bring so much more color 
to my days. 
The thought alone made my heart dance with 
excitement.
